description: This file implements the RunC container management class, including container lifecycle operations (create, start, stop, delete), state retrieval, and configuration handling, using the runc runtime. It defines classes for container info, configuration, and the runner that executes runc commands, as well as container administrator and container classes.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Encapsulates execution of runc commands such as create, exec, delete, and state, managing process invocation and output parsing.

classes.name: Runner::Info
classes.description: Represents the container state information, including PID and status.

classes.name: Runner::Config
classes.description: Represents the container configuration, including environment variables.

classes.name: Runner::Config::ProcessData
classes.description: Holds process-specific configuration data, such as environment variables.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via runc, providing lifecycle methods and status queries.

classes.name: RunCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages multiple RunCContainer instances, providing container creation and lookup.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID and bundle path.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the container.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all containers managed by runc.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates a container object from configuration files found in search paths.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Configures logging options for containers (container-level only).

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with a specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory usage info of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns CPU/processor info of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces associated with the container.

methods.name: InternalPurge
methods.description: Deletes the container if it is running.
